about: Castles, manors, palaces and forts from OpenStreetMap that the Eldoria app shows in addition to its Wikidata places. Fields: i = OpenStreetMap object (n node, w way, r relation, then its number), n = name, a = latitude, o = longitude, c = country, k = kind, s = condition (only when the tags say ruin), l = names in other languages. Built 2026-11-18.
